posts.author: BoxDeliveryAnt
posts.body:
Now that I've thought about testing how games are exported... What is the proper process for exporting the final game in an RPG2K3 project?
That is, in an ".exe" for Windows.
I'm supposed to do it from "Export from Game Disk"?
I haven't gone any further yet. (I haven't pressed the option).

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Yes.
But another, more flexible and more modern way would be creating your own installer with any of the installer tools out there (e.g. InnoSetup, NSIS, ...) or even just provide a ZIP file (my personal favorite but not everyone would agree).
If you go this route, make sure all the RTP files you use have been copied into the project itself and add "FullPackageFlag=1" to RPG_RT.ini to prevent the engine from complaining if no RTP is installed.
